title: A receipt you can crumple and throw away
blurb: A receipt in a <table>. Crumple it and it becomes a ball of paper you can throw at a bin. Smooth it out and it's a table again, with the creases still showing. The ball is 280 triangles cut from one picture of the receipt.
question: Can a 2D canvas turn a table into a ball of paper that can be thrown, and give the table back afterwards with its text selectable and its creases showing?
result: Yes. One picture of the receipt is copied into a plain canvas and drawn as 280 shaded triangles. The receipt is inert while it's a ball. When it's flat again it's the real table with a layer of creases painted over it.
